content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with an existing task","i_want":"to change the details of an existing task and save the changes","so_that":"my task list stays accurate without deleting and recreating tasks","business_description":"Users can correct or update a task after it has been created. The edit form reuses the create form, and an update is shown as saved only after the backend confirms success. The backend validates the update with the same title and due date rules as creation.","business_value":"Keeps task data accurate and avoids losing task history by recreating tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form with a title of 101 characters","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating the 100-character limit is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted, because it is not earlier.","A title containing only spaces: the PRD says the title must be non-empty but does not say whether whitespace counts as empty. Open question for the product owner.","The PRD does not say whether the Creation Date or Last Updated Date changes on update. Open question; this story does not change the Creation Date.","If the task is deleted by another user or session before the update is submitted, the backend returns Task Not Found and the frontend shows an error.","If the database or server fails during the update, the backend returns an internal error and the frontend shows an error without showing the task as updated.","The PRD does not state the wording of the error and success messages; the messages must be shown but their exact wording is not specified."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT or PATCH endpoint for updating a task by ID exists and is documented, and the endpoint is agreed with the frontend team","Update endpoint returns Task Not Found for unknown IDs and changes no data in that case","Title validation (non-empty, maximum 100 characters) and Due Date validation (not earlier than Creation Date) are enforced by the backend on update","Edit form is pre-filled with existing values and uses the same validation messages as the create form","Frontend shows a success message only after a success response and an error message after an error response","No optimistic UI update: the list is not changed before the backend responds","Automated tests pass for all acceptance criteria"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and error responses","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add the update operation of the to-do items endpoints for a task identified by ID. Validate the title (non-empty, maximum 100 characters) and the Due Date (not earlier than the Creation Date). Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, validation errors for invalid input or missing title, and internal errors for server or database failures, without changing stored data on any error.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates the task by ID and returns the updated task on success","Title empty or longer than 100 characters is rejected with a validation error and the stored title is unchanged","Due Date earlier than Creation Date is rejected with a validation error and the stored Due Date is unchanged","Unknown ID returns Task Not Found and changes no data","Database or server failure returns an internal error and changes no data","Error responses use the simple error format agreed for the API"]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the create/edit task form in edit mode so that it loads the existing task values, submits the update to the update endpoint, and shows a success or error message based only on the backend response. The UI must not show the task as updated before the backend responds.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit mode pre-fills all fields with the stored task values","Title and Due Date validation messages are shown from the backend error response","Success message is shown only after a success response; error message is shown after an error response","No optimistic update: the displayed task changes only after the backend returns success","Edit form and create form share one component"]},{"key_slug":"task-update-tests","title":"[QA] Test suite for editing an existing task","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated test suite covering the edit flow end to end: successful update, title and Due Date validation, Task Not Found, backend errors, and the success and error messages shown by the frontend.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-d57336f7","R-9dc414dc","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover every acceptance criterion of the story","Tests confirm that a failed update leaves stored data unchanged","Tests confirm that no success message is shown after an error response","Test suite runs in the CI pipeline and passes"]}]}
